name: EtnProduct newProduct sends the protocol-funded LP to the caller
summary: EtnProduct.newProduct() let any shop-NFT owner create a product token and then addLiquidity() paired 700,000 U from EtnProduct's own balance with the new token, minting the LP to msg.sender (the owner recipient is commented out). The attacker flash-borrowed 9,400 USDT, bought commune NFT 11 for 24.15 BNB, invited itself and paid 1,998 USDT for a shop, called newProduct, burned 600,000 of the 692,965 LP for 606,091 U, and sold 11,253.73 U to UMarket.saleU at par, emptying its USDT.
notes: Target is EtnProduct, not UMarket: UMarket.saleU swaps U for USDT at its set salePrice (1:1) as designed and is only where the free U was cashed out. EtnProduct's router, U and swapAmount were set in its constructor and never changed (its only other transactions are two reverted owner newProduct calls and a team test product at block 20122237); the 3.5m U it held were minted to it at block 20121760, a balance that does not reset the age.

The only earlier newProduct (0xcf157873, 0x203e11b8's 'test1' product) left its LP untouched; 0x203e11b8 is a team test account (it named the product 'test1', sent the deployer 0xa3601967 0.2 BNB, and trades U through UMarket), and the team later burned the U in that pair. No other newProduct call follows the anchor: the team burned EtnProduct's remaining 2.1m U (0xc62c7729) and the attacker contract's 594,837.79 U (0x3b70834c) within an hour.

Loss is EtnProduct's 700,000 U valued at what the attacker realised (rule 12): U's only other market was a U/USDT pair (0xb094b3bc) holding 551 USDT that the attacker did not touch, UMarket held 11,253.73 USDT ($11,254.47 at block time), and the rest of the attacker's U was burned by the team. The 24.15 BNB the attacker paid for commune NFT 11 and the 799.2 USDT of the shop fee that went to the host and pool are attacker costs and are not subtracted; the 1,198.8 USDT commune-owner share of the fee went back to the attacker and is its own money.
